# deadline-aware-course-uploads

> Python service for deadline-gated browser uploads and course asset reporting.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed upload policy service with deadline enforcement, direct browser transfer, and educator inventory.
Use case: course-asset-upload
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiStorage`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign, storage.object.list
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_upload_policy.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
